tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.nutrients: Needs steady potassium at fruiting; zinc shortage common on sandy loam

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.climate: Cool growing season, 20-25 C at grain fill
wheat.nutrients: Nitrogen split across tillering and jointing

rice.name: Rice
rice.soil: Clay loam to loam with good water-holding capacity, pH 5.5-7.0
rice.climate: Warm and humid; irrigation and drainage must be managed carefully
rice.nutrients: Nitrogen is split across early growth and tillering; zinc deficiency is common in flooded soils

maize.name: Maize
maize.soil: Well-drained loam or sandy loam, pH 5.5-7.5
maize.climate: Warm growing season; water stress around tasseling and silking reduces yield
maize.nutrients: Nitrogen demand is high during vegetative growth; phosphorus supports early roots
maize.source: ICAR Indian Institute of Maize Research

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.soil: Deep well-drained black soil or loam, pH 6.0-8.0
cotton.climate: Warm season crop; waterlogging and prolonged cloudy weather increase risk
cotton.nutrients: Balanced nitrogen and potassium are important from squaring through boll development

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane
sugarcane.soil: Deep fertile loam with drainage, pH 6.5-7.5
sugarcane.climate: Long warm growing season with reliable moisture; avoid standing water
sugarcane.nutrients: Nitrogen is needed early; potassium supports stalk strength and maturity

onion.name: Onion
onion.soil: Friable well-drained loam, pH 6.0-7.5; avoid waterlogging
onion.climate: Cool conditions for leaves followed by warm dry weather for bulb maturity
onion.nutrients: Steady nitrogen before bulbing; excess nitrogen late delays curing
onion.source: ICAR-Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research

chilli.name: Chilli
chilli.climate: Warm and moderately dry; high humidity favours leaf and fruit disease
chilli.nutrients: Balanced nitrogen early, with potassium during flowering and fruiting

mustard.name: Mustard
mustard.soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam, pH 6.0-7.5
mustard.climate: Cool dry season; heat during flowering reduces pod set
mustard.nutrients: Sulphur is important for oil formation; nitrogen should be balanced

chickpea.name: Chickpea
chickpea.soil: Well-drained loam to black soil, pH 6.0-8.0
chickpea.climate: Cool dry season; excess humidity and late irrigation increase disease risk
chickpea.nutrients: Use healthy inoculated seed; phosphorus and sulphur support roots and pods

groundnut.name: Groundnut
groundnut.climate: Warm season with moisture during pegging and pod filling; avoid waterlogging
groundnut.nutrients: Calcium and sulphur are important near pegging; avoid excess nitrogen

soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam, pH 6.0-7.5
soybean.climate: Warm season with adequate moisture during flowering and pod filling
soybean.nutrients: Use effective rhizobium inoculation; phosphorus and sulphur support nodulation and seed fill

early_blight.name: Early blight
early_blight.cause: Fungus surviving on crop debris and in soil
early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings on older leaves, yellow halo around spots, lower leaves affected first
early_blight.favours: 22-30 C with leaf wetness over 8 hours, alternating wet and dry spells
early_blight.spread: Wind, rain splash, irrigation splash, infected debris
early_blight.risk_factors: Dense canopy, overhead watering, continuous tomato or potato cropping
early_blight.similar_looking: Septoria leaf spot, magnesium deficiency, sun scald
early_blight.differential: Ringed spots starting on older leaves separate it from nutrient yellowing, which follows vein patterns on younger leaves
early_blight.severity: Moderate to high if untreated at fruiting
early_blight.prevention: Crop rotation, staking, removing lower infected leaves, avoiding overhead wetting of foliage
early_blight.management: Remove and destroy affected leaves. Consult the local KVK or plant clinic before any spray, since product choice depends on crop stage and pre-harvest interval.
early_blight.monitoring: Check 10 plants at 5 spots every 3 days
early_blight.regional_relevance: Widespread across India wherever tomato and potato are grown

hi.name: अगेती झुलसा
hi.symptoms: पुरानी पत्तियों पर गोल छल्लेदार भूरे धब्बे
hi.plain: पत्तियों में फफूंद जैसी बीमारी के लक्षण दिख रहे हैं।

late_blight.name: Late blight
late_blight.cause: Oomycete pathogen spreading through moist air
late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked grey-green patches spreading fast, white fuzzy growth on leaf underside in humid mornings, dark stem lesions
late_blight.favours: Cool nights 10-18 C, humidity above 90%, fog or continuous drizzle
late_blight.spread: Airborne sporangia, can cross a field in days
late_blight.risk_factors: Dense canopy, infected seed material, volunteer plants
late_blight.similar_looking: Early blight, frost injury, bacterial wilt
late_blight.differential: Spreads far faster than early blight and shows white growth on the leaf underside in the morning
late_blight.severity: High, can destroy a field within a week
late_blight.prevention: Healthy seed material, good spacing, destroy volunteer plants
late_blight.management: Act quickly and get the identification confirmed locally. Regional reporting matters because this disease moves between farms.
late_blight.monitoring: Daily inspection when nights are cool and humid
late_blight.regional_relevance: Serious in hills and in north Indian winter potato

hi.name: पछेती झुलसा
hi.symptoms: पत्तियों पर पानी भरे धब्बे जो तेजी से फैलते हैं
hi.plain: तेजी से फैलने वाली झुलसा बीमारी के लक्षण दिख रहे हैं।

yellow_rust.name: Yellow rust
yellow_rust.symptoms: Yellow-orange powdery stripes running along leaf veins, powder rubs off on fingers
yellow_rust.favours: 10-18 C with dew or light rain, common in the north Indian winter
yellow_rust.risk_factors: Susceptible varieties, late sowing, excess nitrogen
yellow_rust.differential: Rust powder transfers to the finger; nutrient striping does not
yellow_rust.prevention: Resistant varieties, timely sowing, balanced nitrogen
yellow_rust.management: Report early appearance to the local agriculture office. Regional rust surveillance matters as much as action in one field.
yellow_rust.monitoring: Scout field borders and shaded patches weekly from January

hi.name: पीली कुंगी
hi.symptoms: पत्तियों पर पीली धारियां जो उंगली पर लग जाती हैं
hi.plain: गेहूं में पीली कुंगी के लक्षण दिख रहे हैं।

aphid.name: Aphid
aphid.identification: Soft pear-shaped insects 1-3 mm, green to black, clustered on tender shoots and leaf undersides
aphid.larva_stage: Nymphs look like small wingless adults
aphid.adult_stage: Winged and wingless forms; winged ones appear when the colony gets crowded
aphid.damage: Curled sticky leaves, honeydew with sooty mould, stunted tips, virus transmission
aphid.season: Cool dry weather, builds up after warm spells
aphid.monitoring: Count colonies on 5 tillers at 10 spots
aphid.threshold: Check state IPM guidance; thresholds vary by crop and stage
aphid.natural_enemies: Ladybird beetles, syrphid larvae, parasitoid wasps
aphid.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen, conserve natural enemies
aphid.management: Protect natural enemies first. Any chemical decision needs local threshold guidance.

hi.name: माहू
hi.damage: पत्ते मुड़ जाते हैं और चिपचिपे हो जाते हैं

whitefly.name: Whitefly
whitefly.identification: Tiny white winged insects that fly up when the plant is shaken; scale-like nymphs on the leaf underside
whitefly.damage: Yellowing, downward leaf curl, sticky leaves, transmits leaf curl virus
whitefly.monitoring: Yellow sticky traps, count adults on 3 upper leaves per plant
whitefly.prevention: Remove virus-affected plants, use barrier crops and traps
whitefly.management: Remove affected plants and use traps. Confirm any chemical choice locally.

hi.name: सफेद मक्खी
hi.damage: पत्ते नीचे की ओर मुड़ते हैं और पीले पड़ते हैं

fruit_borer.name: Fruit borer
fruit_borer.identification: Green to brown caterpillar with light stripes, head buried in the fruit
fruit_borer.egg_stage: Round white eggs on flowers and tender leaves
fruit_borer.adult_stage: Stout light brown moth, active at night
fruit_borer.damage: Circular bore holes in fruit, hollowed fruit, flower drop
fruit_borer.monitoring: Pheromone traps, count bored fruit in 10 plants
fruit_borer.prevention: Pheromone traps, bird perches, timely harvest
fruit_borer.management: Hand collect and destroy bored fruit and caterpillars, and keep traps running.

hi.name: फल छेदक
hi.damage: फलों में गोल छेद दिखाई देते हैं

glossary.meaning: Crop showing wilting from insufficient water

ui_terms.hi: फसल को पानी की कमी का असर हो रहा है।

ui_terms.en: A fungus is affecting the leaves
ui_terms.hi: पत्तियों में फफूंद जैसी बीमारी के लक्षण हैं।

ui_terms.en: The plant is short of a nutrient
ui_terms.hi: पौधे में पोषक तत्व की कमी है।
